ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Ratna Saraf has disclosed the off-market disposal of 2,026,520 equity shares (11.72%) of Asian Hotels (East) Limited via gift to Arun Kumar Saraf and other entities within the promoter group. This inter-se transfer among immediate relatives ensures the aggregate promoter and promoter group holding remains unchanged, indicating no material impact on company control or market dynamics, and thus presenting no red flags. The transaction is exempt under SEBI (SAST) Regulations, reflecting a redistribution of ownership within the existing promoter family.
